item.title: Ohio court rules $350,000 farm sale proceeds go to heirs named in woman's will, not deed beneficiaries

item.title: Appeal Extends Property Dispute: Alabama Power appeals; easement case remains unresolved

item.title: Fewer Japanese subscribe to newspapers. Yet they trust print media more
item.description: Less than half of households in Japan subscribe to a daily newspaper, a level not seen in about 60 years, according to a media tracking report, signalling further evidence of the decline of print as the favoured news medium in the country. While the report shows most Japanese no longer read newspapers, they still trust legacy media more than online media. “It is commonly said that two factors have reduced the number of people subscribing to print newspapers,” said Tetsuo Hatanaka, a professor at... item.description: Desde que León XIV apareció en el balcón del Vaticano el 8 de mayo de 2025 y mencionó en español a su «querida diócesis de Chiclayo», cada uno de los ciudadanos de esta ciudad al noroeste de Perú le esperan con ansias. Chiclayo, capital de Lambayeque, es una de las ciudades más importantes de la cultura moche que se desarrolló en el norte del país entre los siglos I y VII.Chiclayo alberga la única tumba intacta de un gobernador regional prehispánico moche junto a su séquito, cubierto en oro y joyas de incalculable valor, al que se le llamó el Señor de Sipán. item.title: ‘Peruvian pope’ Leo XIV comes home to a country that shaped his life and faith through 'hardship'
item.description: François Picard is pleased to welcome Victor Casallo, Director of the Department of Philosophical and Theological Studies at Antonio Ruiz de Montoya University. Can a Pope shaped by Peru's history of political violence, social inequality and religious activism help a deeply polarized nation heal and rediscover the possibility of dialogue? "We tend to see the other person not as someone who holds a different opinion, but as an enemy." Casallo argues that Pope Leo, the first American-born pontiff's identity cannot be understood through his Chicago origins alone. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Montana Supreme Court rules 10 extra driving miles aren't enough to change a father's custody plan
item.description: The Montana Supreme Court has reaffirmed a previous ruling on a parenting plan modification initiated by Justin Aikins, who sought changes after his ex-wife moved a mere 10 miles away. The court concluded that minor increases in distance do not justify altering existing custody arrangements. Attempts at mediation were unsuccessful, and this decision establishes an important precedent regarding relocations and shared parenting in Montana. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
